name: POC - Count per value (R)
description: Count the rows of a dataframe per value of one column over all participating organizations. The counting is done in R; Python only handles the vantage6 communication. Default: persons per gender (gender_concept_id of the OMOP person table).

functions.name: central_count
functions.description: Count the rows per value of a column over all organizations and add them up (in R).

ui_visualizations.name: Count per value
ui_visualizations.description: Number of rows per value of the chosen column

arguments.name: column_name
arguments.description: Column to count the values of

arguments.name: min_cell_size
arguments.description: Values that occur fewer times at a node are reported as null. 0 switches this off.

functions.name: partial_count
functions.description: Count the rows per value of a column for a single organization (in R).

arguments.name: column_name
arguments.description: Column to count the values of

arguments.name: min_cell_size
arguments.description: Values that occur fewer times are reported as null. 0 switches this off.
